morning.title: Eiffel Tower Summit & Champ de Mars Stroll
morning.description: Pre-booked early access to the Eiffel Tower summit before crowds arrive. Descend through the manicured avenues of Champ de Mars for stunning photography angles.
morning.insider_tip: Book 09:15 elevator slot to bypass the 90-minute general line.

lunch.title: Bistrot Chez France - Authentic Rue Cler Brasserie
lunch.description: Charming Parisian bistro serving classic duck confit, fresh baguettes, and goat cheese salad with outdoor wicker terrace seating.
lunch.transit_from_previous: 🚶 10 min scenic walk via Avenue de la Bourdonnais
lunch.dietary_options: Vegetarian quiche, Ratatouille, and fresh market salads available
lunch.insider_tip: Request a street terrace table to enjoy people-watching along the pedestrian market.

afternoon.title: Musée de l'Armée & Les Invalides Dome
afternoon.description: Marvel at the golden dome of Hôtel des Invalides, Napoleon's tomb, and the expansive courtyard showcasing French military history and baroque architecture.
afternoon.transit_from_previous: 🚶 8 min flat walk along Rue de Grenelle
afternoon.insider_tip: Enter from the Esplanade des Invalides side for an uncrowded security gate.

evening.title: Seine Sunset Cruise & Latin Quarter Dinner
evening.description: Glide along the Seine as the city lights illuminate Notre-Dame and Pont Alexandre III, followed by a candlelit dinner in the historic Latin Quarter.
evening.transit_from_previous: 🚇 12 min direct via Metro Line 10 (La Tour-Maubourg to Cluny)
evening.dietary_options: Extensive wine list, French onion soup, Vegetarian truffle pasta
evening.insider_tip: Board the boat 20 mins before sunset to catch the golden hour transition into dusk.

days.daily_transit_overview: All stops within 1.5 km of the Seine riverfront. Zero metro backtracking.

days.theme: Grand Artistry, Royal Gardens & Marais Boutiques

morning.title: Louvre Museum Masterpieces & Tuileries Garden
morning.description: Curated route through the Denon and Richelieu wings focusing on the Mona Lisa, Winged Victory of Samothrace, and Venus de Milo, followed by a stroll through Tuileries.
morning.insider_tip: Enter via the Carrousel du Louvre underground mall to skip the pyramid plaza queue.

lunch.title: L'As du Fallafel - Famous Rue des Rosiers
lunch.description: Legendary Middle Eastern culinary spot in the historic Jewish quarter known for crisp falafel pitas loaded with fried eggplant, tahini, and spicy red sauce.
lunch.transit_from_previous: 🚶 15 min pleasant stroll through Palais Royal gardens
lunch.insider_tip: Join the takeaway queue on the left; it moves three times faster than table dining.

afternoon.title: Place des Vosges & Le Marais Designer Boutiques
afternoon.description: Relax under the symmetric vaulted arcades of Paris's oldest planned royal square, visit Victor Hugo's historic residence, and explore concept art boutiques.
afternoon.transit_from_previous: 🚶 6 min walk along Rue des Francs-Bourgeois
afternoon.insider_tip: Grab a salted butter caramel macaron from Carette on the northwest arcade.

evening.title: Speakeasy Jazz & Natural Wine Bar Experience
evening.description: Sip natural organic French wines accompanied by artisanal cheese boards at a hidden cellar speakeasy featuring live acoustic jazz performers.
evening.transit_from_previous: 🚶 12 min walk north towards Boulevard Beaumarchais
evening.dietary_options: Artisanal dairy cheeses, vegan tapenade, gluten-free crackers

days.daily_transit_overview: Linear progression from Tuileries eastward to Place des Vosges. Minimal walking strain.

morning.title: Sacré-Cœur Basilica & Secret Vineyard of Montmartre
morning.description: Ride the funicular to the Romano-Byzantine white stone basilica for the city's highest natural viewpoint, then wander past the quiet Clos Montmartre vineyard.
morning.insider_tip: Climb the 300 dome steps for a 360-degree panoramic vista stretching 30 km.

lunch.title: Le Moulin de la Galette - Historic Windmill Bistro
lunch.description: Dine beneath a preserved 17th-century wooden windmill immortalized by Renoir, indulging in beef bourguignon or mushroom risotto.
lunch.transit_from_previous: 🚶 7 min downhill amble past Place du Tertre
lunch.dietary_options: Vegetarian truffle risotto, seasonal velouté soups
lunch.insider_tip: Book an outdoor garden patio seat if the weather is clear.

afternoon.title: Musée de Montmartre & Renoir Gardens
afternoon.description: Step into the former studios of Pierre-Auguste Renoir, Suzanne Valadon, and Raoul Dufy overlooking the pastoral northern vineyard.
afternoon.transit_from_previous: 🚶 5 min cobbled walk through Rue Saint-Vincent
afternoon.insider_tip: The Renoir swing featured in his 1876 masterpiece is recreated in the garden.

evening.title: Moulin Rouge Cabaret & Pigalle Nightlife
evening.description: Experience the world's most famous belle époque cabaret revue with champagne, acrobats, and the iconic French Cancan dance.
evening.transit_from_previous: 🚶 10 min stroll down Rue Lepic past the Amélie cafe
evening.dietary_options: Gourmet champagne paired tasting menu with vegetarian options
evening.insider_tip: Smart dress code strictly enforced (jackets preferred, no sneakers or shorts).

days.daily_transit_overview: Clustered entirely on Montmartre hill. One-way funicular ride avoids stair exhaustion.

morning.title: Senso-ji Temple & Nakamise-dori Market
morning.description: Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple founded in 645 AD. Pass beneath the giant red Kaminarimon thunder gate and browse Edo-period confectionery stalls.
morning.insider_tip: Receive your fortune (omikuji) at the central incense burner pavilion.

lunch.title: Daikokuya Tempura - Edo Style Crispy Prawns
lunch.description: Operating since 1887, serving crispy sesame-fried tempura bowls drizzled in secret rich soy glaze over steaming rice.
lunch.transit_from_previous: 🚶 3 min walk west of Senso-ji main hall
lunch.dietary_options: Vegetable tempura bowls available on request
lunch.insider_tip: The tatami second-floor room offers authentic seating without shoes.

afternoon.title: Ueno Park & Tokyo National Museum
afternoon.description: Explore Japan's largest art and samurai heritage museum showcasing ancient katana swords, lacquerware, and Kimono textiles within serene park grounds.
afternoon.transit_from_previous: 🚇 5 min via Ginza Line from Asakusa to Ueno
afternoon.insider_tip: Check the Honkan Japanese Gallery first for the National Treasures collection.

evening.title: Ameyoko Market Alleyways & Yakitori Izakaya
evening.description: Lively post-war market street under the elevated train tracks packed with sizzling yakitori skewers, draft Asahi beer, and vibrant street banter.
evening.transit_from_previous: 🚶 4 min stroll down south exit of Ueno Station
evening.dietary_options: Shiitake mushroom skewers, grilled edamame, tofu dishes
evening.insider_tip: Sit at the outdoor red lantern tables directly beneath the train viaduct.

days.daily_transit_overview: East Tokyo cluster. 1 metro stop or 15-minute walk between districts.

morning.title: Meiji Jingu Shrine & Yoyogi Evergreen Forest
morning.description: Pass through towering 12-meter cedar Torii gates into a tranquil sacred forest of 100,000 trees planted in dedication to Emperor Meiji.
morning.insider_tip: Write a wooden prayer tablet (ema) to hang at the sacred camphor tree.

lunch.title: Afuri Harajuku - Yuzu Citrus Ramen
lunch.description: Light, refreshing golden broth infused with aromatic Japanese yuzu citrus fruit, charcoal-grilled chashu pork, and springy whole-grain noodles.
lunch.transit_from_previous: 🚶 6 min walk from Harajuku station east exit
lunch.dietary_options: Full Rainbow Vegan Ramen bowl with lotus root and vegetables
lunch.insider_tip: Purchase your meal ticket at the automated vending machine at entrance.

afternoon.title: Takeshita Street & Cat Street Fashion Promenade
afternoon.description: Wander the colorful epicenter of kawaii fashion, quirky crepe stands, and vintage fashion boutiques leading along tree-shaded Cat Street.
afternoon.transit_from_previous: 🚶 3 min walk into Takeshita pedestrian alley
afternoon.insider_tip: Cat Street is the serene, hip alternative to the crowded Takeshita strip.

evening.title: Shibuya Sky Observation Deck & Scramble Crossing
evening.description: Stand 229 meters high on the open-air rooftop observing the world's busiest pedestrian crossing pulse with thousands of neon-lit people below.
evening.transit_from_previous: 🚶 12 min walk along Meiji-dori Avenue into Shibuya
evening.dietary_options: Sky lounge tapas and craft cocktails with panoramic views
evening.insider_tip: Book sunset tickets 4 weeks in advance; tripods are not permitted on the open roof.

days.daily_transit_overview: Walkable linear route from Meiji Shrine south through Harajuku into Shibuya.

morning.title: Tokyo Historic Landmark & Landmark Pavilion (Day 3)
morning.description: Explore the primary architectural marvel of Hillside Viewpoints & Bohemian Enclaves. Enjoy uncrowded morning access and guided photography spots.
morning.insider_tip: Arrive 15 minutes before ticket gates open to capture pristine photos without crowds.

lunch.title: Trattoria & Artisanal Bistro Hillside
lunch.description: Authentic local dining serving fresh regional delicacies, farm-to-table salads, and crisp local refreshments.
lunch.transit_from_previous: 🚶 5 min leisurely walk down pedestrian promenade
lunch.dietary_options: No Restrictions selections featured prominently on seasonal menu
lunch.insider_tip: Ask the waiter for the daily chalkboard chef special.

afternoon.title: Tokyo Heritage Museum & Artisan Courtyards
afternoon.description: Discover regional craftsmanship, historic tapestries, and tranquil courtyards showcasing the cultural evolution of Tokyo.
afternoon.insider_tip: The interior shaded courtyard is an ideal spot to rest with local gelato or espresso.

evening.title: Sunset Overlook & Rooftop Dining in Tokyo
evening.description: Watch the sunset bathe the city rooftops in amber glow, followed by an intimate dinner featuring signature regional courses and live music.
evening.transit_from_previous: 🚶 9 min walk toward the illuminated square
evening.dietary_options: Full culinary pairings catering to No Restrictions diets
evening.insider_tip: Reserve rooftop terrace seating 30 minutes ahead of scheduled golden hour.

days.daily_transit_overview: All 4 activities tightly clustered within 1.8 km. Easy walking route with low transit stress.
